card.name: Linking words after force and gravity
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs that come right after a physics term such as force, gravity, weight or pressure, e.g. "force of gravity pulling" or "total force on". It fires in physics and science explanations.

modes.label: Verb or preposition after force
modes.description: A verb or preposition follows a force or gravity phrase and leads into what the force acts on.
modes.example: Measure the force of gravity<< pulling>> on objects.

modes.label: Linking word in physics sentences
modes.description: A word such as to, will, any or a sits within a sentence about gravity, atmosphere or weight.
modes.example: Thus, Gold's gravity is insufficient<< to>> hold its atmosphere, which is pulled loose

card.writes: It pushes down words like gravity, pressure and forces, and favors geometry and drawing-dimension words.
card.plain: It activates on the small word right after a physics term like force or gravity, where the text is about to say what the force acts on.
